title: Course Schedule
description:
To take course a, first finish b for every pair [a,b]. Determine whether there is an order in which every course can be finished. Circular requirements make it impossible.

Example 1:

Input: numCourses = 2, prerequisites = [[1,0]]
Output: true

Course 0 can be taken before course 1.

Example 2:

Input: numCourses = 2, prerequisites = [[1,0],[0,1]]
Output: false

The two courses require each other.

Example 3:

Input: numCourses = 0, prerequisites = []
Output: true

There are no requirements to violate.

Constraints:

  • 0 <= numCourses <= 100; course IDs are 0 through numCourses - 1.
  • 0 <= prerequisites.length <= 1000; every pair [course, prerequisite] uses valid, distinct IDs.
  • Pairs are unique; an empty schedule is possible.

exampleTestCases.explanation: Course 0 can be taken before course 1.
The two courses require each other.
There are no requirements to violate.
